thread:
Alyssa: Quick check-in on Saffron's onboarding. They're seeing 280ms p50 but spikes to 900-1.2s on peak. Customer flags cost too. Thinking proactive: propose int8 quant + model swap to 7B-distilled on overflow routing, plus prefix caching. Thoughts?
Kumar: Yep that's what we saw in the report. Spikes correlate with long-context prompts from their doc-upload flow. Cost is a concern for them.
Mike: Agree with quant pilot. Two things: (1) run a small canary of int8 on 5% of requests with latency observability, (2) create model-fallback policy: primary = saffron-13b, fallback = saffron-7b-distilled, overflow tier = latency-optimized instance group. Also tune batch size lower for long-context.
Jane: For the canary, recommend these guardrails: 1) monitor perplexity delta + major token rejection rate; 2) track p95/p99 latency and error rate; 3) alert if hallucination rate increases by >2% on eval set.
Alyssa: Can we roll this within their Dedicated pool so data isolation remains? They made that a requirement for renewal.
Mike: Yes — Dedicated supports canary routing by route tag. We'll create a canary route: 
```
route: /v1/generate/saffron
canary_percent: 5
primary_model: saffron-13b
fallback_model: saffron-7b-distilled
quant_profile: int8-fast
metrics: [latency_p95, tokens_per_request, eval_perplexity]
```
Add prefix/KV cache for doc-upload flows: cache prefix of system prompt + first 512 tokens.
Kumar: What's timeline? Renewal review in 3 weeks, they'd like a performance demo before then.
Alyssa: Plan: week 0 (this week) — deploy canary + short eval suite; week 1 — collect metrics and run customer-facing demo; week 2 — expand to 25% if OK; week 3 — discuss commit for reserved capacity or routing SLA.
Jane: I'll add a smoke test harness and a synthetic prompt set capturing long docs. Mike, can you prepare a short eval set from their anonymized examples? Kumar, can you confirm customer approves 5% canary on Dedicated?
Kumar: Confirmed, they approved 5% canary on Dedicated with audit logs. Also requested a brief enablement session for their infra team.
Alyssa: I'll schedule the enablement session. Also capturing feedback: we'll ask them to log perceived latency and semantic fidelity during demo via quick form.
deploy-bot: Canary route saffron-canary created by Mike at 2024-11-20T14:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
Mike: Added dashboards (latency by model/fallback, eval regressions). Linking to dashboard in thread: https://redwood.console/d/abcd-saffron-canary
Alyssa: Great — thanks team. I'll sync with renewal manager after week 1 metrics. :thumbsup:
